name: fit-app
description: Personal training, nutrition tracking, and AI coaching app
enginesReason: 22.5 is the floor, not 20: the repository tests run real SQL against node:sqlite (src/db/testUtils.ts), which was added in 22.5. On an older Node every database test fails at import rather than at an assertion, which looks like a broken checkout rather than a wrong engine.
overridesReason: React Native tolerates exactly ONE copy of React; two instances cause 'Invalid hook call' crashes at runtime rather than a build failure. Transitive deps regularly pull a second React version, so this pins the tree to one copy. The version must track the Expo SDK — 19.1.0 for SDK 54 (React Native 0.81). Update it in lockstep whenever the SDK moves.
